top_signals.title: India’s crude oil imports spike 13% on year in Jul-26
top_signals.summary: OPEC stated in a latest update that Indias crude imports remained strong in July, as refinery runs moved above the five-year average for this time of year. top_signals.title: Altimeter's Gerstner blasts researchers voicing AI extinction warnings, questions 'political agenda'
top_signals.summary: Brad Gerstner responded to the flurry of AI stories this week after a researcher quit his job at Anthropic, accusing AI companies of "gambling with our lives."

top_signals.summary: This consultation seeks views on the design of a new Mayoral power to create visitor levies on overnight stays in England.

top_signals.title: Burando Energies completes first physical bunker delivery in Norway
top_signals.summary: Bunker supplier Burando Energies has supplied an undisclosed volume of marine gasoil (MGO) to Dutch marine contractor Heerema Marine Contractors’ heavy-lift vessel Balder in Åmøyfjorden, Norway. The vessel was supplied using an oceangoing bunker barge, a Burando Energies representative told ENGINE. The operation marks Burando Energies’ first physical bunker supply in Norway.
